cohort: The study participants were five Early Childhood Development (ECD) centres and 35 caregivers in Traditional Authority Chekucheku, Neno District, Malawi.
finding: The study found that while most community-based childcare centres had permanent structures and safe water sources, many lacked essential facilities like adequate playing materials, sleeping arrangements, and consistent provision of all essential learning areas, alongside variable sanitation and limited male involvement in service delivery.
